card.name: Commas in lists of medical conditions
card.fires_on: Commas or closing parentheses ending an item in a list of diseases or risk conditions, and the start of blood-related words like hematologic or hemoglobinopathies.

modes.label: List punctuation
modes.description: A comma or closing parenthesis after a disease name inside a list of conditions.

modes.description: The opening piece of words beginning hem- or hemat- after 'patients with' or similar.

card.plain: It marks the end of one listed condition, especially in lists of illnesses, and the start of blood-disorder terms.
